name: Rage Mage
body:
You weave your bloodrage talents with other magical traditions.

Prerequisite(s): Bloodrage, able to cast spells from a class other than legendary bloodrager.

Benefit(s): You can cast spells from other classes while in bloodrage, but only of a spell level up to your legendary bloodrager level. You also gain a +2 bonus to Concentration checks while in bloodrage.

Special: This feat counts as Combat Casting for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.
